claim: 你把才華收在裡面，不搶鋒頭；這份收斂和對人的防備，只差一線。
en: You keep your talents tucked inside and do not seek the limelight; that restraint sits a hair's breadth from wariness of others.

claim: 你的盤偏英華內斂：才華收而不露，可以成就大事；一生不宜爭最高位置、出鋒頭。
en: Your chart leans toward hidden brilliance: you keep your gifts under wraps and can still achieve great things; all your life, avoid fighting for the very top spot or the limelight.

claim: 你的盤偏疑慮：表面不動聲色，心裡對人處處設防，人生反因此多了困境。
en: Your chart leans toward suspicion: outwardly calm, inwardly guarded against everyone, and that wariness itself makes life harder.

claim: 你容易為感情的事煩惱。
en: You are prone to worrying over matters of the heart.

claim: 你少了外來的光照，心裡的顧慮較難自然化開。
en: You lack outside light to lift the shadows, so your worries do not easily dissolve on their own.
limit: 原文：只有不成格局的子午巨門或與擎羊同度時才需太陽光輝；太陽在辰優於在戌，即子宮巨門優於午宮。午宮巨門會戌宮落陷太陽。

claim: 你的盤是「石中隱玉」的大格局：才華內斂，可以成就大業。
en: Your chart forms the great "jade hidden in stone" pattern: talent held within, capable of great achievement.
limit: 石中隱玉＝子午巨門化祿或化權，三方四正不見四煞（羊陀火鈴）。空劫原文另列（p356.b003），不算入「煞」。

claim: 你的盤是次一等的「石中隱玉」：早年多些阻滯，出身也稍遜。
en: Yours is a lesser form of the hidden-jade pattern: more obstacles early on, and a somewhat humbler start.
limit: 原文另說祿存同度須見吉曜始許富貴，條件未寫，所以不講成就。

claim: 你的盤格局受損，收斂容易轉成重重疑慮。
en: Your pattern is weakened: reserve easily turns into layer upon layer of suspicion.

claim: 你心裡的疑慮較少，看人看事比較寬。
en: You carry fewer inner doubts, and see people and things more generously.
limit: 原文：天機化祿不成格局，只減少內心疑慮。

claim: 你較難把自己完全收起，忍不住想表現。
en: You find it hard to keep yourself fully under wraps; the urge to show what you can do breaks through.
limit: 原文：天梁化祿降低石中隱玉的格局。

claim: 你不太適合與人合夥，合作關係容易出問題。
en: Partnerships do not suit you well; joint ventures tend to run into trouble.
limit: 原文「子午巨門一般兄弟宮不利，故不宜與人合作」；遲婚一句不寫。

claim: {decades}這段時間，往往是你成事的時候。
en: The years {decades} are often when you make things happen.

claim: {decades}這段時間，是你較能發揮、有收穫的時候。
en: The years {decades} are when you can best show what you can do and reap results.
limit: 原文：祿存同度者成功常在見化祿、迭祿大運；無祿者必須行至見祿之大運流年始主發越。

claim: {decades}這段時間，往往是你較易受挫的時候：或因爭權，或因求富過了頭。
en: {decades} tend to be the years you are most likely to stumble, whether from fighting for power or chasing wealth too far.
limit: 原文「化祿化權者，均常在巳垣大運失敗；化權者敗在爭權，化祿者敗在求富」。巳宮：巨門坐午時是廉貪，坐子時是空宮（對宮亥廉貪）。
note: 原文「化祿者敗在求富而壓足」，「壓足」疑為「饜足」。

claim: 這十年大致良好，有利受教育，際遇也佳。
en: This decade is broadly good: favourable for education, with good openings.
limit: 原文前提是石中隱玉（巨門化祿權、不見煞）。

claim: 這十年較多阻滯，起步不如別人順。
en: This decade brings more obstacles, and your start is less smooth than others'.

claim: 這十年你的心思容易反覆多變，疑心也在這時養成。
en: This decade your mind changes back and forth, and your habit of suspicion takes root.

claim: 這十年對你有利，做事較順。
en: This decade favours you, and things go more smoothly.

claim: 這十年雖有崎嶇，卻是開創的運勢，也磨出你沉著的性格。
en: This decade has rough patches, but it opens new ground and hardens your composure.

claim: 這十年起伏反覆，疑心加重，容易和親人或夥伴鬧翻。
en: This decade swings back and forth, your suspicions deepen, and falling out with family or partners comes easily.

claim: 這十年運勢反覆的次數較多，也可能離鄉發展。
en: This decade fortunes turn more often, and you may move away to pursue your path.

claim: 這十年是進財的運程。
en: This decade is a time for income to come in.

claim: 這十年容易進退失據，自作主張而招損失。
en: This decade you may lose your footing, act on your own judgment, and take losses for it.

claim: 這十年機會耀眼，卻是一場考驗：仍然居於次席、不公開表態，才能避開挫敗。
en: This decade dazzles with opportunity but is really a test: stay in second place and keep your views private to avoid a fall.

claim: 這十年反而能讓你吐氣揚眉。
en: This decade, of all times, lets you hold your head high.

claim: 這十年對你反而有利。
en: This decade actually works in your favour.

claim: 這十年對你不利，容易處處受阻。
en: This decade works against you, and you meet obstacles at every turn.

claim: 這十年容易有破耗動盪。
en: This decade is prone to losses and upheaval.
limit: 原文：天機無論如何吉化會吉，對任何本質的巨門都不利；僅巨門化祿可減破蕩。

claim: 這十年的破耗動盪會減輕一些。
en: The losses and upheaval of this decade are somewhat eased.
limit: 原文「僅於巨門化祿之時，才可以減少破蕩之性」。

claim: 這一年不宜生任何改變之心。
en: This year is no time to set your heart on any change.

claim: 這一年宜不爭、多忍讓。
en: This year, avoid contests and give way more often.

claim: 這十年大致對你不利。
en: This decade broadly works against you.

claim: 這十年容易被表面的機會引誘出頭，結果受人排擠攻擊。
en: This decade surface opportunities may lure you into the open, only for you to be pushed aside and attacked.

claim: 這十年容易一起即跌。
en: This decade, what rises quickly tends to fall just as fast.
limit: 「一起即跌」原文限「當吉化或會吉之時」（p083.b010）；冇吉時原文只話紫破宮度大致不利。

claim: 這十年是收獲的運程。
en: This decade is a time of harvest.

claim: 這十年對你有利。
en: This decade is in your favour.

claim: 這十年容易捲入爭執糾紛。
en: This decade you are prone to being drawn into disputes.
limit: 原文「詞訟糾紛」，只寫爭執。

claim: 這十年是可以發財、出頭的好運。
en: This decade is a good one for making money and making your name.
limit: 原文：石中隱玉的巨門，最喜行太陰入廟、見祿、會諸吉（兩粒或以上）的宮垣。

claim: 這十年也是好運，只是格局稍次。
en: This decade is also a good one, if on a smaller scale.
limit: 原文：石中隱玉的巨門行太陰落陷見吉，格局稍次。

claim: 這十年和你不相合。
en: This decade does not suit you.

claim: 這十年的阻力更大。
en: The resistance this decade is heavier still.
limit: 原文「見化忌及煞曜者尤為不利」。

claim: 這十年你收斂的氣質容易減弱，忍不住想表現。
en: This decade your reserve tends to slip, and you itch to show yourself.

claim: 這十年容易惹上感情糾纏，陷入苦戀。
en: This decade you may get caught up in emotional entanglements and painful attachments.

claim: 這一年容易生出不必要的改變。
en: This year you are prone to making changes you do not need.
